note: The main banks: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge, the one bank with a branch in Longyearbyen, is the bank read. Its price list for private customers (read 30 October 2026): the SpareBank 1 Kredittkort and the SpareBank 1 Kredittkort Ung (for young customers, an age the game doesn't check), both free to hold, at nominal rates of 23.46% and 21.62% a year; a cash withdrawal in Norway, or abroad in Norwegian kroner, costs 40 kroner plus 1% (one in a foreign currency abroad costs nothing, not modelled); spending in another currency carries a 2% currency surcharge; interest-free credit for up to 45 days; a minimum payment of 3.2% of the credit used, at least 250 kroner (5%, at least 300, on the Ung; agreements signed before 15 May 2019 keep 2.5%, not modelled); and an over-limit fee of 125 kroner (70 on the Ung). The reminder fee is 'according to the state's rates', a figure the price list doesn't give, so no late fee is written; nor are the transfer and bill payment fees, the 11-kroner paper invoice fee and the optional insurances. This file kept the Kredittkort, read on 29 October 2026, and adds its terms and the Ung.
